jordana: CI perf alert — PR 2045 microbench 'batcher_coalesce' p99 +12% on mainline CI run
perf-ci-bot: [ALERT] 1837770000 PR=2045 bench=batcher_coalesce_micro delta=+12% p99 link=https://ci.internal/runs/12345
tim: on it, grabbing the flamegraphs and perf profile now
jordana: repro command i used: `./tools/bench run --bench batcher_coalesce --pr 2045 --gpu a100` — see ~+10% p99 locally too
hao: quick skim of profiles: kernel selector is oscillating between matmul_opt and matmul_fallback during batch coalescing, looks like batch window hysteresis flipped
rachel: do we have the raw microbench seqlen distribution? CI harness might have heavier long-tail than local runs
jordana: paste from CI log:
```
[bench] avg_batch_size: 3.1 -> 2.0
[bench] batch_wait_ms: 9.2 -> 21.7
[kv] kv_cache_hit: 0.74 -> 0.62
[kernel] selector: matmul_opt <-> matmul_fallback toggles @8k tokens
```

tim: that lines up — coalescer is shrinking batches and forcing kernel fallback more often -> p99 spike
hao: bisecting now, suspect recent change to adaptive coalescer bounds (commit 6f7e8c9) which introduced 'wider if long_sequences' toggle
perf-ci-bot: bisect started: target=PR_2045 suspect_range=[6f00000..7000000]
hao: bisect result: top candidate commit 6f7e8c9 "adaptive-coalescer-graft" — reproduces locally
jordana: curious why this only hits microbench and not full e2e tests — microbench has skewed seqlen seeds that interact with sampler
tim: quick patch idea: tighten the widen_coalesce condition and add a kernel-stability guard so we avoid flip within a 50ms window
hao: proposed patch snippet:
```
if seq_len > 1024 and not kernel_flipping_recently():
    widen_coalesce = True
else:
    widen_coalesce = False
```
rachel: i worry about adding timing logic in hotpath but okay as temporary guard for CI pass
jordana: alternative is revert commit 6f7e8c9 to unblock rollout, then reintroduce improved heuristic in follow-up
tim: created PR 2050 with hysteresis fix and a unit microbench that simulates flip pattern
deploy-bot: CI triggered for PR=2050 build=456 https://ci.internal/build/456
perf-ci-bot: CI perf recheck for PR=2050 bench=batcher_coalesce_micro delta=+0.7% p99 (within threshold) — STATUS: PASS
jordana: nice. plan: ship PR 2050, monitor canary, don't revert mainline. adding a regression test to prevent future kernel-flip regressions
hao: also adding a small telemetry gauge for kernel_switch_rate so ops can alert if flip rate exceeds X per minute	im: noted — i'll add changelog + monitoring playbook
jordana: thanks all — big help, nice catch :thumbsup:
rachel: putting postmortem note in the perf board and linking the bisect details
